swordfish_wipe_the_high_wall_clear_of_gr: Green gone. It sped past to inspect the work.
Scrubbed the top run. The sword saw itself and showed off.
swordfish_peer_down_the_length_of_the_sw: Tip intact. A dangerous thing, to have a point.
No chips. It has been cutting nothing with real discipline.
swordfish_flip_a_wingful_of_flakes_acros: Flakes across the top. Streak, slash, gone.
It hit the water so hard I got wet from the wall.
swordfish_dangle_a_flake_on_a_reed_for_t: Slashed it clean. I held on to the reed and a bit of pride.
Missed the flake. Hit the dream.
swordfish_trail_a_wingtip_fast_along_the: Teased it into a streak. I could not tell which end was which.
I move a wingtip, it moves the world.
swordfish_settle_a_wing_on_the_wall_to_s: It stopped. Hovered. Looked, for once, like a fish.
Slow wing, slow sword. A deal was struck.
swordfish_raise_a_reed_hoop_for_the_stre: Through the hoop and out the other side. I did not see it.
A hoop for a streak. We call it a ride.
swordfish_race_the_streak_and_lose_glori: Lost by nine wall lengths. It lapped me before I started.
The only race with a finish line I never saw.
swordfish_fence_the_swordfish_with_a_ree: Parried twice. Hit once, by accident. Honour satisfied.
Reed versus sword is not a fair fight, but it is a loud one.
swordfish_measure_the_sword_against_a_re: A third of it is sword. The rest is attitude.
Longer than my leg. Longer than my patience.
swordfish_bow_to_the_flash_of_silver: Bowed. Its sword went past my ear. Respect, both ways.
I bow fast, it passes faster.
swordfish_argue_over_who_is_the_sharper: It is a fish on a stick. I am, regardless, sharper.
Lost on points. It had several.
swordfish_shout_a_countdown_for_the_run: Three, two, one. It was already at the far end.
Starter's pistol for an animal that does not need one.
swordfish_flinch_when_the_sword_hits_the: Eight inches from my face. It missed on purpose, I tell myself.
That sword has a will of its own. And a hell of an aim.
swordfish_hold_two_hoops_for_one_streak: One streak, two hoops, perfect. I only missed my hoop.
A pass through both. The fish is the only one who looks calm.
swordfish_flank_the_swordfish_from_the_t: Ping, pong, fish. The slowest ball game ever, played at speed.
Tap-tap left, tap-tap right, whoosh. Teamwork is exhausting.
swordfish_keep_score_of_the_slashes_with: Six and seven. The fish ignored the dispute and scored eleven.
Two scorers, two totals. A fish keeps the real count.

swordfish_wipe_the_high_wall_clear_of_gr.label: Wiping the green off the upper wall with long upward swipes of a wing so the top run is clear to watch

swordfish_polish_a_clean_pane_for_the_sw.label: Polishing a clean pane at the top of the wall in tight circles so the sword and the long eye can be seen properly

swordfish_peer_down_the_length_of_the_sw.label: Peering all the way down the length of the sword for any chip or crack in the tip, tracking its slow turn at the wall

swordfish_brush_the_foam_skin_off_the_wa.label: Brushing the thick foam skin off the water line with a wing so the top run is not a swamp of bubbles

swordfish_rap_the_sign_with_a_wing_edge.label: Rapping the sign with the edge of a wing three times, the loud bell the sword has learned to answer

swordfish_flip_a_wingful_of_flakes_acros.label: Flipping a wingful of flakes across the top of the tank so they skitter on the water and the sword comes slashing

swordfish_dangle_a_flake_on_a_reed_for_t.label: Dangling a flake on the end of a reed a hand above the water line, snatching it back as the sword slashes up at it

swordfish_trail_a_wingtip_fast_along_the.label: Trailing a wingtip fast along the upper wall in quick jerks to tease the sword into one long hot run

swordfish_settle_a_wing_on_the_wall_to_s.label: Settling a still wing flat against the wall at mid height until the keyed-up fish slows to a hover and stops slashing

swordfish_hold_a_flake_to_the_wall_for_t.label: Holding a flake flat to the wall with the tip of his bill while the long sword turns and the small mouth takes it from the other side

swordfish_raise_a_reed_hoop_for_the_stre.label: Raising a reed bent in a hoop at the top of the tank with both ends held, so the swordfish threads it at speed

swordfish_race_the_streak_and_lose_glori.label: Racing the streak along the wall at a flat run, wings back, and losing before he has taken three strides

swordfish_duck_when_the_sword_comes_at_t.label: Ducking low with a whoop each time the sword jabs at the wall, springing straight up again after it passes

swordfish_fence_the_swordfish_with_a_ree.label: Fencing with a reed against the wall while the sword jabs back from the other side, lunge for lunge

swordfish_follow_the_wake_along_the_top.label: Following the white wake along the top with a wingtip, always three strides back from the fish that made it

swordfish_fence_steps_on_the_ledge.label: Fencing with a bill-point along the left ledge in short darting steps, lunge and recover, as the real sword flashes past

swordfish_count_the_slashes_against_the_.label: Counting each slash against the wall as a toe lift, unable to keep up past six

swordfish_measure_the_sword_against_a_re.label: Holding a reed up beside the sword to measure how much of the fish is sword and how much is fish

swordfish_listen_for_the_whoosh_before_t.label: Listening hard at the wall for the whoosh that comes before the streak, bill cocked at the sound

swordfish_squint_at_the_big_round_eye.label: Squinting at the big round eye that tracks every move he makes, bill an inch from the wall at the top

swordfish_sniff_the_spray_from_the_top.label: Sniffing the sea spray flung over the coping by a hard turn, then sneezing salt

swordfish_doze_after_the_morning_run.label: Dozing on the right ledge after the morning run, bill on his chest, one foot tucked

swordfish_sit_on_the_lip_between_runs.label: Sitting at the front lip with his feet tucked in the lull between runs, watching the tank for the next streak

swordfish_wait_for_the_first_streak_of_t.label: Waiting stock-still at the wall for the first streak of the day to cut the water, wings pinned

swordfish_lean_on_the_left_post_and_watc.label: Leaning on the left pier post with his arms folded, watching the swordfish carve the top of the tank

swordfish_sulk_when_it_will_not_come_to_.label: Sulking at the base of the wall with his bill in the air because the swordfish has gone deep and will not play

swordfish_fold_in_against_the_cold_wind_.label: Folding both wings in tight against the cold that comes off the top of the tank, bill buried in the chest

swordfish_spread_a_wing_to_dry_in_the_su.label: Spreading one wing wide at the left ledge to dry in the sun after a splash and then the other

swordfish_cool_both_feet_at_the_lip_on_a.label: Cooling his feet one at a time on the cold front lip on a hot noon, the swordfish a blur beyond the wall

swordfish_bow_to_the_flash_of_silver.label: Bowing to the flash of silver as the swordfish tops out against the wall and falls away, a crisp and speedy dip

swordfish_present_the_blade_to_the_morni.label: Presenting the long blade to the morning with a sweep of the wing along the top of the tank, a herald without a trumpet

swordfish_argue_over_who_is_the_sharper.label: Arguing with the swordfish about which of them is the sharper, jabbing his bill at the sword and then at his own head

swordfish_pose_on_the_ledge_with_a_bill_.label: Posing on the right ledge with his bill thrust up like a sword, wings back, hero of a very small ship
